0x10252EA0.name: StTrigger_FindIndexAtLeast
0x10252EA0.evidence: when param_2 is in range and the flags at +0 have bits 4 and 8 set, walks the entries at +0xF for the first one whose key at +4 is at least param_3, stores its index at +0 and returns it, else -1
0x10252EA0.summary: Finds the first trigger entry whose key is at least a given value.
